cards.example_en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我会试着在晚饭前把灯修好。
cards.explain_zh: try to do强调努力；try doing强调试试办法。

cards.example_en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
cards.example_zh: 我们得在交通变得更拥堵之前出发。
cards.explain_zh: leave 的过去式和过去分词均为 left。

cards.example_en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
cards.example_zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。
cards.explain_zh: a number of接复数谓语；the number of接单数谓语。

cards.example_en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
cards.example_zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
cards.example_zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。
cards.explain_zh: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

cards.example_en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
cards.example_zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。
cards.explain_zh: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

cards.example_en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
cards.example_zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I understood only the opening part of that story.
cards.example_zh: 那个故事我只读懂了开头的部分。

cards.example_en: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 关于共用厨房，你说得很有道理。
cards.explain_zh: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

cards.example_en: The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
cards.example_zh: 这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
cards.example_zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。
cards.explain_zh: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。

cards.example_en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
cards.example_zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？
cards.explain_zh: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

cards.example_en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
cards.example_zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。
cards.explain_zh: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

cards.example_en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
cards.example_zh: 我们今天午饭后在图书馆外见吧。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为met；meet要求时意为满足。

cards.example_en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
cards.example_zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。
cards.explain_zh: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

cards.example_en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
cards.example_zh: 学校应鼓励学生坦诚谈论压力，并在需要时寻求帮助。
cards.explain_zh: talk about接话题；talk to或with接人。

cards.example_en: There is something soft inside this little box.
cards.example_zh: 这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。
cards.explain_zh: 修饰词放后面，如something useful；作主语用单数。

cards.example_en: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
cards.example_zh: 每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
cards.example_zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为put；放置义通常需接地点。

cards.example_en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
cards.example_zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。
cards.explain_zh: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

cards.example_en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
cards.example_zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。
cards.explain_zh: 变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

cards.example_en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 我对烹饪的兴趣始于祖母的厨房。
cards.explain_zh: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

cards.example_en: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
cards.example_zh: 学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
cards.example_zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

cards.example_en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
cards.example_zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。
cards.explain_zh: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

cards.example_en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
cards.example_zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
cards.example_zh: 每个孩子都提着一个小篮子走进花园。
cards.explain_zh: each后接单数名词；each of后接复数名词或代词。

cards.example_en: We walk to school together along the river.
cards.example_zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。
cards.explain_zh: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

cards.example_en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
cards.example_zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。
cards.explain_zh: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

cards.example_en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
cards.example_zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
cards.example_zh: 架子太高了，我够不着。
cards.explain_zh: high常指位置或程度；人的身高用tall。

cards.example_en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
cards.example_zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。
cards.explain_zh: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

cards.example_en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
cards.example_zh: 门一开，那只狗就跑走了。
cards.explain_zh: off强调离开或关闭；of常表示所属，勿混淆。

cards.example_en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
cards.example_zh: 我们要坐的下一班公交车大约十分钟后发车。
cards.explain_zh: “下周”用next week，不加the；the next week指随后一周。

cards.example_en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
cards.example_zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。
cards.explain_zh: at the end指末尾；in the end指最终。

cards.example_en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
cards.example_zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。
cards.explain_zh: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

cards.example_en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
cards.example_zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？
cards.explain_zh: 间接疑问句用陈述语序：I know why he left。

cards.example_en: Don't talk while you are eating.
cards.example_zh: 吃饭时不要说话。

cards.example_en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
cards.example_zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。
cards.explain_zh: 指整个世界通常用the world；商界为the business world。

cards.example_en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
cards.example_zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
cards.example_zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。
cards.explain_zh: last/next/this week前不加介词。

cards.example_en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
cards.example_zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
cards.example_zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。
cards.explain_zh: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

cards.example_en: Public libraries play a role in supporting community learning.
cards.example_zh: 公共图书馆在支持社区学习方面发挥作用。

cards.example_en: It might rain this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 今天下午可能会下雨。

cards.example_en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
cards.example_zh: 在这里骑车必须戴头盔。
cards.explain_zh: must是情态动词；mustn't表禁止，不是“不必”。

cards.example_en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
cards.example_zh: 在咖啡馆吃过晚饭后，我们一起走回家。
cards.explain_zh: home作副词时前面不加to：go home。

cards.example_en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
cards.example_zh: 我出门从来都带着水瓶。
cards.explain_zh: 通常放在实义动词前，be动词或助动词后。

cards.example_en: Does the price include breakfast and a clean towel?
cards.example_zh: 这个价格包含早餐和一条干净毛巾吗？
cards.explain_zh: include常列出部分内容，不表示完整清单。

word.example_en: The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.
word.example_zh: 随着数字通信工具的改进，居家办公的人数有所增加。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
word.example_zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
